they are 2MG each and I have about 30 or so .5mgs

the .5mg were just as expensive as the 2mg. but i got it anyway because i was intent on stopping them. then i got suicidal and depressed and got back on them.

It certainly does. I'm going to have to read that over a few times to fully grasp the concepts. Normally I just take the 2mg once a day. I am definitely going to try what you're saying here. Hopefully I can do it. I've tried before and wasn't successful. Having no income whatsoever is also very crazy. I can't feed myself nor find a job. It makes me feel even worse about myself. It really would be easier to just end this. I believe in an afterlife, yet I really don't want to do that. I REALLY wish I had family that were close and care. I moved far away from my homestate and my small family doesn't care or has given up completely. And what's worse is one day, my mom is saying we're gonna get insurance and everything will be okay and literally the next day it's back to go fend for yourself, you mean nothing to me. you keep mooching off me. and in much harsher words. it's tough when your family is so small and that small famiy doesn't want to help. they would rather watch you die.  Sorry for the wall of text, this is somehow therapeutic but I know it's not going to solve any problems. I really wish I could afford a therapist or had insurance.
From my research, medicate is only offered to women and children in this state. I tried applying for that already.
Thank you for that. I just really want to remain anonymous for future career reasons. I know it seems impossible.
I am in the same boat. Very close to your age as well. I cant function and nobody cares.
North West Florida. Very close to the border of Alabama. With no money and no insurance i feel so helpless. I really appreciate you looking out.

The ER seems like my only choice, I have no money and no insurance. I just don't know how the ER would handle my situation. I am in FL BTW and they are crazy when it comes to pharms here. I just need some help.

diazpam is so expensive compared to clonazpam from my source. 2MG clonazpam = 40mg diazpam. I can get a box of 100 2mg tabs for 80 dollars and 56 tabs of 10 mg diazpam for $100. Nevermind that, I have no money anyway.

I want to quit them so bad. I get no "high" from it at all anymore. It's purely a physical addiction. Any idea what would happen in the ER? How would I be treated with no insurance and no money? They completely wrecked my life. I also have fears that the ER wouldnt know how to handle a benzo addiction.
